responses.question: Do you think adventure trips are appropriate for students?

arguments.title: 歷奇旅行可以提供書本以外的學習
arguments.description: 安全而有指導的活動可讓學生以真實場景理解自然和文化知識，與課堂學習互相補足。其合適程度取決於活動安排而非歷奇標籤。
arguments.englishDemo: **Adventure learning** can complement **classroom education** through **real-world experiences**, **guided observation** and **practical understanding** when the programme is suitable. Those benefits depend on appropriate guidance.

arguments.title: 學生可透過適度挑戰練習自我管理
arguments.description: 準時集合、遵守程序及整理個人物品可培養責任感。這些挑戰不一定要非常危險，只需讓學生有能力作出真實選擇。
arguments.englishDemo: **Age-appropriate challenges**, **self-management**, **responsible choices**, **daily routines** and **supervised independence** can make student adventures worthwhile. This approach helps learners grow without excessive pressure.

arguments.title: 團隊活動能培養有效溝通與互助
arguments.description: 旅程需要同學互相提醒、分工和解決小問題，與獨立完成作業的學習形式不同。教師可藉此協助學生反思合作方法。
arguments.englishDemo: **Group tasks** develop **communication skills**, **peer support**, **shared decisions** and **conflict management**, making a trip a useful teamwork opportunity. Such skills remain useful at school afterwards.

arguments.title: 學生活動必須有合適的風險管理
arguments.description: 若行程涉及開放水域、地下空間或夜間戶外活動，學校就應核實專業監督及退出方法。沒有足夠保障時，活動再刺激也不應照常進行。
arguments.englishDemo: **Student safety** requires **risk assessment**, **trained supervision**, **emergency procedures** and **safe alternatives** for each high-risk setting. A clear plan matters more than excitement.

arguments.title: 不同身體能力的學生不應被排除
arguments.description: 部分學生可能無法浮潛或走完整段洞穴路線，但仍能透過其他方式學到相關知識。學校需先評估活動的可調整程度，而不是假設人人相同。
arguments.englishDemo: **Inclusive travel** means offering **adapted activities**, **accessible routes**, **equal learning opportunities** and respectful support for **different abilities**. A suitable choice should never humiliate someone.

arguments.title: 不合理的同輩壓力可能使學生逞強
arguments.description: 學生可能因害怕被朋友取笑而參加自己並不適合的活動。學校應清楚說明拒絕或退出是受尊重的選擇，不能以冒險程度判斷勇敢。
arguments.englishDemo: **Peer pressure** can undermine **informed consent**. **Personal boundaries**, **voluntary participation** and supportive teachers protect **student dignity** during challenging activities. Saying no must remain an acceptable option.

arguments.title: 旅行時間不應嚴重影響學業
arguments.description: 若出發日期令學生錯過重要學習或評估，教育收益便可能與課業壓力互相抵銷。學校應按學年安排活動及後續支援。
arguments.englishDemo: **Academic schedules**, **missed lessons**, **assessment pressure**, **make-up support** and **careful timing** help determine whether an adventure is appropriate. Timetables need checking before families commit.

arguments.title: 冒險旅行可能增加家庭不必要的費用
arguments.description: 若活動需要昂貴裝備、交通或個人支出，即使學校提供部分資助，仍可能讓部分家庭難以參加。財務公平是評估適切性的重要一環。
arguments.englishDemo: **Family expenses**, **equipment costs**, **financial assistance**, **equal access** and **reasonable pricing** all affect whether a student trip is fair. Extra spending should never be assumed affordable.

arguments.title: 沒有足夠指導的高風險歷奇不適合學生
arguments.description: 學生可能有學習熱誠，但熱誠不能代替技術和經驗。若承辦商未能交代資格、監督和應急安排，學校應拒絕或修改活動。
arguments.englishDemo: **Poor supervision**, **unsafe conditions**, **unclear procedures**, **inexperienced participants** and **avoidable harm** make an adventure unsuitable until safeguards improve. Safety cannot depend on student enthusiasm.

arguments.title: 學生的準備程度比年齡標籤更重要
arguments.description: 同一年級的學生也可能有不同技能、成熟度和健康需要。是否適合參與應根據具體活動和個別情況，而非只按年級作結論。
arguments.englishDemo: **Individual readiness** includes **physical ability**, emotional confidence, **relevant training**, **decision-making maturity** and **activity requirements**. No single school-year label establishes equal readiness.

samples.label: Model A — 有條件支持
samples.text: Yes, I think they can be appropriate, provided that the organisers choose age-suitable activities and provide qualified supervision. Students can learn teamwork, responsibility and practical problem-solving in places outside the classroom. However, schools must consider health needs and offer alternatives when students cannot or do not want to join a particular activity.

samples.label: Model B — 質疑高風險安排
samples.text: Some adventure trips are suitable, but I would be cautious about activities involving deep water or difficult underground routes. Students have different abilities, and peer pressure might push someone to take an unnecessary risk. I would support educational exploration with good safeguards, not a trip that treats danger itself as proof of personal growth.

responses.question: Would you prefer to travel to far away places or to stay near Hong Kong?

arguments.title: 遠方旅行讓學生接觸不同文化
arguments.description: 有些學生希望見識與香港生活差異較大的地方，因而傾向長途旅行。實際體驗若配合尊重及反思，可幫助他們建立更開放的視野。
arguments.englishDemo: I might choose **distant destinations** for **cultural diversity**, **new experiences**, **different lifestyles** and **broader perspectives** that challenge familiar assumptions. I would still respect each community.

arguments.title: 遙遠景觀可能提供香港少有的學習場景
arguments.description: 澳洲珊瑚礁、冰島火山洞穴和摩洛哥沙漠，都是學生未必能在本地直接接觸的主題場景。這可增加探索動機，但不代表遠方一定比近處更好。
arguments.englishDemo: **Unfamiliar landscapes**, **rare environments**, **fieldwork opportunities**, **scientific curiosity** and **new learning contexts** are reasons I might travel far. Their educational value depends on thoughtful activities.

arguments.title: 海外旅行有助增加跨文化溝通經驗
arguments.description: 學生在其他國家可能需要以英語或其他方法與人交流、適應新禮儀。這些練習有價值，但需要事先準備及尊重當地居民。
arguments.englishDemo: **International communication**, **language practice**, **cultural sensitivity**, **confidence abroad** and **adaptability** could make a distant journey educational. Every encounter requires respect rather than assumptions.

arguments.title: 較近的目的地可以節省交通時間
arguments.description: 若假期短，長途飛行和轉機可能佔去大量時間，降低真正活動的比例。附近旅程可能讓學生將更多時間用於休息和學習。
arguments.englishDemo: I might prefer **nearby destinations** because **shorter journeys**, **less travel fatigue**, **flexible schedules** and **more activity time** suit a brief holiday.

arguments.title: 本地或鄰近旅行通常較容易調整安排
arguments.description: 距離較近的旅程在部分情況下可減少長途交通及接駁的複雜程度。若天氣或健康情況變動，學校或家庭也較容易重新規劃。
arguments.englishDemo: **Local travel** may offer **simpler logistics**, **shorter transfers**, **easier rescheduling** and **practical flexibility** when unexpected problems arise. This can be reassuring for families.

arguments.title: 近距離旅行有機會減少整體開支
arguments.description: 住宿、交通和證件安排可能使長途旅行較昂貴，但實際價格仍要按行程比較。考生可指出自己會優先考慮可負擔且有學習價值的路線。
arguments.englishDemo: My preference depends on **travel costs**, **affordable transport**, **accommodation prices**, **family budgets** and **value for money**, not distance alone. Actual prices still require comparison.

arguments.title: 探索香港附近也能發現陌生文化與自然
arguments.description: 就算不飛往遠方，學生也未必已經了解本地山海、歷史及社區。選擇近處不等於沒有新發現，重點是觀察的深度。

glossary.chinese: 較少人認識的文化遺產

arguments.englishDemo: **Nearby exploration** can reveal **hidden heritage**, **local nature**, **community stories** and **fresh discoveries** without an overseas flight. Distance does not measure curiosity or enjoyment.

arguments.title: 長途旅行的環境代價值得納入考慮
arguments.description: 長途交通可能涉及較多排放，但不能在缺乏比較資料時斷言每種近程交通都更環保。考生可將環境足跡列作偏好準則之一。
arguments.englishDemo: **Transport emissions**, **travel distance**, **environmental impact**, **lower-carbon options** and **responsible choices** should influence how I plan a journey. These factors should form part of the choice.

arguments.title: 時間充裕時會選遠方，時間短時會選附近
arguments.description: 考生不一定需要永遠偏好同一種旅行方式，可按假期長短調整選擇。這是一個清晰的條件式答案，亦方便加入實際例子。
arguments.englishDemo: For a **long holiday**, I may enjoy **overseas exploration**. During a **short break**, **nearby attractions** and **efficient planning** would be more practical.

arguments.title: 同行者需要可能比目的地距離更重要
arguments.description: 與家人旅行時可能要考慮不同年齡、體力和健康狀況，選擇未必只由個人心願決定。考生可提出尊重同行者作合理條件。
arguments.englishDemo: **Travel companions**, **family needs**, **health considerations**, **shared enjoyment** and **reasonable distances** may matter more to me than the destination itself.

responses.question: Would you prefer going on a trip with your school or with your family?

arguments.title: 與同學旅行有利建立新友誼
arguments.description: 學校旅行通常讓學生與平日未必熟悉的同學一起活動。若有互助和公平分組，旅程可能創造新的友誼。
arguments.englishDemo: A **school trip** creates **shared experiences**, **new friendships**, group activities and **peer conversations** that can strengthen **class relationships**. Good planning can ensure nobody feels excluded.

arguments.title: 老師帶領的行程通常較注重教育目標
arguments.description: 學校旅行可由老師安排研究、導賞和反思活動，幫助學生把旅行與學習連結。可是學習安排是否有效仍視乎實際設計。
arguments.englishDemo: I may prefer **teacher-led visits** because **learning objectives**, **guided tasks**, **group discussion** and **educational feedback** give the journey a clear purpose.

arguments.title: 學校旅行有機會訓練獨立生活
arguments.description: 在適當監督下，學生可練習整理用品、守時和自己處理簡單問題。這與完全由家長包辦的旅行有不同成長機會。
arguments.englishDemo: A **school-organised journey** may develop **personal independence**, **time management**, **self-organisation** and shared responsibility while **adult support** remains available. Students still need sensible boundaries and guidance.

arguments.title: 家庭旅行能增加親子相處時間
arguments.description: 平日家人可能因工作和學業難以一起活動，旅行可以提供較長時間交流。若考生珍惜與家人相處，這便是選擇家庭旅行的合理理由。
arguments.englishDemo: I value **family time**, **shared meals**, **meaningful conversations**, **stronger family bonds** and **lasting memories**, so travelling with relatives appeals to me.

arguments.title: 與家人同行能更容易按個人需要調整節奏
arguments.description: 家庭成員較熟悉彼此的作息、飲食與休息需要，可能較容易改變行程。相比之下，學校需要同時協調很多學生，靈活度可能較低。
arguments.englishDemo: **Flexible schedules**, **personal preferences**, **meal choices**, **rest breaks** and **family planning** can make a private holiday more comfortable. I appreciate having that freedom.

arguments.title: 學校團隊活動可能令內向學生較有壓力
arguments.description: 部分學生不喜歡長時間集體活動，亦可能需要獨處和安靜時間。若考生偏好較小的家庭團體，可如實表達，不必批評其他同學。
arguments.englishDemo: **Large groups** can create **social pressure** for some students. **Quiet time**, **personal space** and **smaller gatherings** may make family travel more appealing.

arguments.title: 家庭旅行可能有更大個人參與決策空間
arguments.description: 有些家庭願意讓孩子選擇景點和活動，而學校必須按整體教育目的安排。考生可以說明自己喜歡與家人共同商量路線。
arguments.englishDemo: I enjoy **joint planning**, **destination choices**, **personal interests**, **flexible activities** and **family discussions** when deciding how to spend a holiday.

arguments.title: 學校旅行可提供特別的專業學習機會
arguments.description: 某些團體行程可能由老師或專業嚮導安排講解，內容較符合課程。若考生重視學術觀察，便可能選擇學校旅行。
arguments.englishDemo: A **specialist tour** with **expert guidance**, **subject knowledge**, **structured fieldwork** and **student questions** may provide learning opportunities beyond an ordinary holiday.

arguments.title: 與家人旅行可能帶來較強的熟悉和安全感
arguments.description: 在陌生地方，部分學生會因為與熟悉的家人在一起而較放鬆。這種情緒需要屬合理的個人偏好，尤其對首次遠行的人。
arguments.englishDemo: **Familiar companions**, **emotional comfort**, **family support**, **trusted routines** and **reduced anxiety** may make me prefer travelling with relatives. This is especially important on a first journey.

arguments.title: 目的與同行者可以按情況改變
arguments.description: 考生可以表示教育探究時偏好學校旅行，而休息或家庭慶祝時偏好與家人同行。這種條件式選擇比簡單比較哪一類永遠更好更準確。
arguments.englishDemo: I would choose a **school excursion** for **group learning** and a **family holiday** for **personal relaxation**. My **travel purpose** matters most.

responses.question: Are you interested in exploring marine life?

arguments.title: 海龜和魚類的生活方式令人好奇
arguments.description: 有些學生喜歡海洋生物，是因為想知道不同物種如何覓食、活動和適應海洋。觀察應在專業指導和適當距離下進行。
arguments.englishDemo: I am interested in **sea turtles**, **fish behaviour**, **marine habitats**, **animal adaptation** and **responsible observation**, especially when guided by knowledgeable adults.

arguments.title: 珊瑚礁的生物多樣性值得探索
arguments.description: 海洋中不同物種互相依靠，珊瑚礁可成為理解生態關係的例子。對生物科有興趣的學生可以把科學學習作為答案重點。
arguments.englishDemo: **Coral reefs** contain **diverse organisms**, **ecological relationships**, **food chains** and fragile habitats. Exploring them can make **marine biology** more interesting.

arguments.title: 探索海洋可增加保育責任感
arguments.description: 若學生發現塑膠垃圾或不負責任的旅遊可能影響海洋生物，便可能更關心自身行為。關心海洋不必以近距離觸碰動物作前提。
arguments.englishDemo: **Marine conservation** encourages **waste reduction**, **responsible tourism**, **wildlife respect** and **environmental action** beyond an enjoyable snorkelling trip. Small choices can influence sensitive coastal environments.

arguments.title: 水下景觀提供不同於陸地的自然體驗
arguments.description: 海洋生物的移動、色彩和棲地可能讓學生有新鮮感，與日常所見不同。欣賞這種美感也可成為興趣，而不必具備進階科學知識。
arguments.englishDemo: I enjoy **underwater scenery**, **colourful fish**, **coral shapes**, **natural movement** and **visual discovery** because they offer a different world to explore.

arguments.title: 不擅長游泳也可以關心海洋生物
arguments.description: 學生即使沒有能力參加浮潛，仍可透過展館、紀錄片或岸上觀察了解海洋。這可避免把對自然的興趣與某種身體能力劃上等號。
arguments.englishDemo: **Marine documentaries**, **aquarium education**, **shore observations**, **accessible learning** and **scientific curiosity** let people explore marine life without entering deep water.

arguments.title: 擔心深水的人可以有條件地表達興趣
arguments.description: 考生可以說自己對海洋生物感興趣，但對深水或開放水域感到不安。這是理性界線，不會削弱對生態學習的熱誠。
arguments.englishDemo: I have **interest in marine life**, but **deep-water anxiety** affects my choices. **Safe alternatives**, **qualified guidance** and **personal boundaries** matter to me.

arguments.title: 海洋保育可能啟發日後的職業想像
arguments.description: 觀察海洋生物可能讓學生好奇科學家、保育人員或生態教育工作者的工作。可將這種興趣描述為可能性，而非保證未來職業選擇。
arguments.englishDemo: **Ocean science** can introduce **conservation careers**, **field research**, **scientific skills** and **career exploration**. This may broaden students' ideas about future study.

arguments.title: 欣賞動物不代表應該盡量靠近牠們
arguments.description: 有些人希望與海龜合照，但學生可強調保持距離、減少噪音和避免干擾的責任。這展示對海洋生物真正的尊重。
arguments.englishDemo: **Animal welfare**, **safe distances**, **non-intrusive viewing**, **wildlife etiquette** and **ethical photography** should guide any marine-life encounter. Real respect sometimes means keeping our distance.

arguments.title: 學習海洋知識可幫助理解人類與環境的聯繫
arguments.description: 研究海洋垃圾、水質及生物棲地，可讓學生看到生活習慣如何影響遠方生態。這些問題也與香港海岸環境相關。
arguments.englishDemo: **Marine pollution**, **water quality**, **coastal ecosystems**, **daily habits** and **environmental connections** show why ocean learning matters even to people living in cities.

arguments.title: 可以對海洋科學有興趣但不喜歡水上活動
arguments.description: 有些學生更喜歡閱讀、攝影或研究，而不是游泳或浮潛。回答時可分開「探索知識」與「親自下水」兩種形式。
arguments.englishDemo: I prefer **marine research** to **water sports**. **Reading articles**, **scientific videos** and **land-based learning** satisfy my interest without requiring direct participation.

responses.question: What makes an adventure trip memorable?

arguments.title: 親眼看見從未接觸過的景觀會留下深刻印象
arguments.description: 當學生首次看到珊瑚礁、巨大洞穴或壯麗星空，可能因強烈對比而難忘。可是景色不是唯一因素，個人意義同樣重要。
arguments.englishDemo: **Unforgettable scenery**, **first-time experiences**, **strong emotions**, **a sense of wonder** and **personal meaning** can make an adventure stay in memory.

arguments.title: 成功完成有難度的任務能帶來成就感
arguments.description: 在合理支援下克服一項原本不熟悉的挑戰，可能讓學生對自己的能力有新看法。應強調安全的成長，而非以冒險程度衡量價值。
arguments.englishDemo: **Achieving a goal**, **manageable challenges**, **new confidence**, **self-belief** and **personal progress** can make a trip memorable beyond its scenery. The challenge should remain voluntary and safe.

arguments.title: 與朋友互相照顧會形成共同回憶
arguments.description: 旅程中替同學打氣或合作處理困難，可能成為多年後仍記得的事情。人與人的互動有時比景點本身更有意義。
arguments.englishDemo: **Shared memories**, **mutual support**, **teamwork moments**, **friendship bonds** and **emotional connection** may outlast the details of individual attractions. The relationship often matters more than the destination.

arguments.title: 意外變化有時能成為最有趣的故事
arguments.description: 遇上小型延誤或改行程，若團隊能安全應對，日後可能成為值得分享的故事。這不代表真正危險的事故應被浪漫化。
arguments.englishDemo: A **small surprise** or **unexpected change** may create a **travel story** through **creative problem-solving** and **group resilience**, provided everyone remains safe.

arguments.title: 真正學到新知識會使旅行有持久價值
arguments.description: 如果學生能清楚說出自己對海洋、火山或天文的一項新理解，旅行便不只是短暫娛樂。可解釋知識如何改變日後的觀察角度。
arguments.englishDemo: **New knowledge**, **first-hand evidence**, **changed perspectives**, **lasting curiosity** and **meaningful learning** make an adventure more valuable over time. Students may keep asking questions after returning.

arguments.title: 與當地人士的真誠交流會令人難忘
arguments.description: 一段友善的對話或文化解說，可能令學生更懂得尊重不同生活背景。此類互動比只看見景點外觀更容易帶出人物故事。
arguments.englishDemo: **Local encounters**, **cultural stories**, **respectful conversations**, **human connections** and **new understanding** can make a journey personally memorable. A single conversation can change how I see a place.

arguments.title: 適度緊張後的安全完成會留下強烈感受
arguments.description: 學生初次嘗試新活動時可能有點緊張，完成後因發現自己能應付而感到開心。前提是挑戰自願、符合能力且有專業支援。
arguments.englishDemo: **Initial nerves**, **careful preparation**, **safe completion**, **a sense of relief** and **earned confidence** can create lasting memories. The experience should still suit individual ability.

arguments.title: 特殊聲音和氣味可能比照片更易喚起回憶
arguments.description: 海浪、洞穴回音或夜間營地的氛圍，可能成為學生記憶中的重要細節。這些感官經驗不一定能由照片完整保留。
arguments.englishDemo: **Natural sounds**, **distinctive smells**, **sensory details**, **emotional memories** and **atmosphere** can make a trip vivid long after returning home. They form part of the lived experience.

arguments.title: 旅途中反思失敗與困難能帶來成長
arguments.description: 如果學生遇到挫折後得到適當協助，反思自己如何調整便能增加經驗的意義。難忘不一定只來自成功，也可來自學會面對限制。
arguments.englishDemo: **Learning from setbacks**, **honest reflection**, **adaptive thinking**, **personal resilience** and **new strategies** may make a journey meaningful without glorifying danger.

arguments.title: 能自由選擇參與方式的旅程更容易留下正面回憶
arguments.description: 當學生能按能力和興趣選擇活動，就更可能主動投入並感到被尊重。被迫參與或遭嘲笑則可能留下負面印象。
arguments.englishDemo: **Personal choice**, **comfortable participation**, **respectful support**, **positive engagement** and **emotional safety** help students remember an adventure positively. This reduces the risk of unwanted pressure.

arguments.title: 旅行結束後仍維持的習慣最有價值
arguments.description: 旅途中學到的保育或自理習慣，如果回家後仍能實踐，便可留下更長遠的影響。這種改變也能成為旅行值得紀念的原因。
arguments.englishDemo: **Lasting habits**, **environmental responsibility**, **greater independence**, **post-trip action** and **personal development** make an adventure memorable through everyday change. The benefits continue well beyond the itinerary.

arguments.title: 旅行是否難忘也取決於與誰同行
arguments.description: 同一個景點與不同人同行，可能帶來很不一樣的感受。支持自己的老師、家人或朋友能讓體驗更安心，也令故事有情感連結。
arguments.englishDemo: **Travel companions**, **shared laughter**, **trusted support**, **strong relationships** and **special moments** often shape how people remember a journey. People may matter more than the place.

samples.label: Model B — 不喜歡下水但願意了解
samples.text: A **small surprise** or **unexpected change** may create a **travel story** through **creative problem-solving** and **group resilience**, provided everyone remains safe.

samples.text: For me, an adventure becomes memorable when I learn something new and overcome a challenge that is suitable for my ability.
